gems.title: 你能看到一切
gems.summary: 在被判入狱前的34天，臭名昭著的硅谷创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯邀请了一支持怀疑态度的摄制组记录她的一举一动。起初这是一部关于神秘罪犯的私密肖像，却演变成一场持续3年、坠入深渊的迷幻之旅。
gems.summaryEn: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enig
gems.whyWatch: 以纪录片镜头贴身记录霍姆斯入狱前34天，既是罪案肖像也是荒诞人性观察。
gems.whyWatchEn: An intimate, unsettling documentary portrait that follows Holmes in the 34 days before prison, blending true-crime intrigue with absurd character study.
gems.audience: 喜欢真实罪案、硅谷题材与人物纪录片的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of true crime, Silicon Valley stories, and character-driven documentaries.

gems.title: 罗摩衍那：王子传奇
gems.summary: 阿逾陀国的王子罗摩本应继承王位，但为了维护父亲的誓言，他甘愿放弃王权，带着妻子悉多和弟弟罗什曼那被流放森林十四年。在流放期间，罗摩一家在山林中苦修并斩妖除魔。然而，平静被打破——十首魔王罗波那因贪婪和邪念，化身苦行僧诱骗并掳走了悉多。罗摩在寻找妻子的过程中，结识了神猴哈奴曼与猴王须羯哩婆，组建了强大的盟军，准备跨海远征楞伽（罗波那的王国），誓要从魔王手中夺回爱妻。
gems.summaryEn: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater chal
gems.whyWatch: 史诗神话与动作冒险融合，视觉与情感格局兼具，是近期被低估的东方奇幻。
gems.whyWatchEn: An epic blend of mythology, action, and adventure with strong visual and emotional scope—an underrated Eastern fantasy.
gems.audience: 喜欢神话史诗、东方奇幻和大场面冒险的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy mythic epics, Eastern fantasy, and large-scale adventures.

gems.title: 荒野丛林
gems.summary: 普鲁和同班同学柯蒂斯误入一片禁忌魔法森林，林中遍布魔法生灵、忠心伙伴与强大劲敌。二人踏上一场凶险万分的营救之旅，要从神秘女子亚历山德拉统领的鸦群手中，救出被掳走的婴儿弟弟麦克。
gems.summaryEn: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted ba
gems.whyWatch: 魔法森林营救之旅兼具童话暗黑感与成长冒险，画风和想象力亮眼。
gems.whyWatchEn: A magical-forest rescue adventure with dark fairy-tale charm, coming-of-age stakes, and striking imagination.
gems.audience: 喜欢奇幻动画、童话冒险与家庭共赏的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of fantasy animation, fairy-tale adventures, and family-friendly viewing.

gems.title: 黑球
gems.summary: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。
gems.summaryEn: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
gems.whyWatch: 以三个时代串起西班牙同性恋者的命运，历史厚度与私人情感并重。
gems.whyWatchEn: Weaves three eras of Spanish gay lives into a moving story that balances historical weight with intimate emotion.
gems.audience: 喜欢历史叙事、LGBTQ+题材与跨时代群像的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in historical narratives, LGBTQ+ stories, and multi-era ensembles.

gems.title: 柳条人
gems.summary: 海边小镇里有一个身上散发臭味的打渔女，饱受狭隘的邻居嘲讽，而她为自己找了个柳条做成的丈夫。这段离经叛道的爱情在保守的小镇里引起了怒火、嫉妒和轩然大波。
gems.summaryEn: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to
gems.whyWatch: 渔女与柳条丈夫的怪诞爱情，用民间寓言式喜剧搅动保守小镇。
gems.whyWatchEn: A bizarre romance between a fisherwoman and a wicker husband, using folk-fable comedy to unsettle a conservative town.
gems.audience: 喜欢怪诞爱情、黑色幽默与民间寓言风格的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of offbeat romance, dark humor, and folk-fable storytelling.

gems.title: 侠探杰克
gems.summary: 退役宪兵杰克·雷彻独自游走各地，凭借敏锐头脑与强悍身手追查案件，在一次次危机中揭开隐藏于罪案背后的阴谋。
gems.summaryEn: 退役宪兵杰克·雷彻独自游走各地，凭借敏锐头脑与强悍身手追查案件，在一次次危机中揭开隐藏于罪案背后的阴谋。
gems.whyWatch: 硬汉悬疑与单元案件结合，节奏利落，雷彻式正义感很上头。
gems.whyWatchEn: A crisp blend of hard-boiled mystery and case-of-the-week structure, powered by a highly satisfying Reacher-style sense of justice.
gems.audience: 喜欢硬汉探案、动作犯罪剧的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of hard-boiled investigation and action-crime series.

gems.title: 菜鸟老警

gems.summaryEn: Alexi Hawley执笔﹑Liz Friedlander导演的ABC警察剧《菜鸟老警 The Rookie》过去被直接预订成剧，由《灵书妙探 Castle》男主Nathan Fillion主演。《菜鸟老警》根据真人真事改编，Nathan Fillion饰演主角John Nolan，他是洛杉矶警局里最老的菜鸟警察。John离开了舒适的小城镇，来到洛杉矶追求自己的警察梦；此刻他身边的其他菜鸟都
gems.whyWatch: 中年转行当警察的设定带来新鲜视角，案件、职场与团队温情平衡得好。
gems.whyWatchEn: The middle-aged rookie cop premise offers a fresh angle, balancing cases, workplace drama, and team warmth.
gems.audience: 喜欢轻快警匪剧、职场故事与团队群像的观众
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy lighter police procedurals, workplace stories, and ensemble chemistry.

gems.title: 梦魇绝镇
gems.summary: 一群陌生人误入一座无法逃离的小镇，白天寻找出路，夜晚则必须躲避森林中出现的怪物。博伊德带领居民求生，同时调查小镇的诡异规则、失踪者与隐藏在背后的神秘力量。
gems.summaryEn: 一群陌生人误入一座无法逃离的小镇，白天寻找出路，夜晚则必须躲避森林中出现的怪物。博伊德带领居民求生，同时调查小镇的诡异规则、失踪者与隐藏在背后的神秘力量。
gems.whyWatch: 小镇困局与夜行怪物设定持续制造压迫感，悬疑规则层层展开。
gems.whyWatchEn: The trapped-town premise and nocturnal monsters sustain constant dread while the mystery rules unfold layer by layer.
gems.audience: 喜欢密闭空间悬疑、怪物恐怖与慢热解谜的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of claustrophobic mystery, creature horror, and slow-burn puzzle-box storytelling.
